answer.justification: Only output-level data is available. The exact-match rate is 0.078, so the model is not the base reference. A median first divergence of 8.5 fits both quantized (10-17) and fine-tuned (5.5-8) about equally, sitting between them. Text rates stay close to the reference's: disclaimers 6.2% in both, no stage directions, very short replies 6.2% in both. Refusals dropped 3 and added 1, which is slightly more than quantized usually shows (0-1 each) but within the fine-tuned range. The low edit distance favors quantized over fine-tuned (0.56-0.65), but fine-tuned remains close, so confidence is modest.
